# Phase 5 public election information

Implement only the approved Phase 5 in the existing MEMS.Public WASM application. Resolve tenants from root URL slugs, discover municipalities dynamically, show election branding/details, positions, paged/searchable candidates, profiles and secure media using existing API DTOs. Use anonymous same-origin requests, no Data/EF/Identity/server dependencies or secrets in WASM. Adapt the existing gateway runtime while retaining seven solution projects and SQL configuration/data/volume. Preserve Admin; test actual Admin-to-Public synchronization with owned temporary records and clean up. Assignment 1 is strictly read-only. No Phase 6 voting choices, storage, printing, backend vote records, Git, Azure, COMP4977, deployments or ZIP. Record real browser/regression/persistence results and stop after Phase 5.
